summary: Retested UX fix for stale-state between Kasbon Sementara tab and Jurnal Akuntansi tab in /cashbook. The onCashChanged={loadAll} prop from CashBook to KasbonTab is correctly invoked after settle/reopen/remove, causing parent to refresh cash_transactions, balance and monthly summary. All 8 review scenarios pass without page reload.

critical_code_review_comments: CashBook.jsx is now ~1032 lines; consider splitting KasbonTab, JournalTab, BookTab, and modal components into separate files under /pages/cashbook/ for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

KasbonTab has a local load() and receives onCashChanged. Both are awaited sequentially in settle/reopen/remove which is fine, but consider Promise.all(load(), onCashChanged?.()) to reduce perceived latency.
Console warnings from Recharts about width(-1)/height(-1) appear on non-cashbook pages during initial navigation; not related to this fix but worth investigating.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral kasbon 'Budi UX' during test; deleted at end of flow. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix at /app/frontend/src/pages/CashBook.jsx line 162 (onCashChanged={loadAll} passed to KasbonTab) and lines 814/822/831 (calling onCashChanged() after settle/reopen/remove) is verified working. No further action needed for this bug.
rca of the issue: Original bug: KasbonTab maintained its own state and called load() only on its local list; parent CashBook's txData/balance/summary were not refreshed after settle/reopen/remove, so Jurnal Akuntansi tab and StatCards showed stale data until page reload. Fix: Pass parent's loadAll as onCashChanged prop and invoke it after each mutation, so parent re-fetches /cashbook/transactions, /cashbook/balance, /cashbook/summary and re-renders Jurnal tab and StatCards immediately.
